title: 見本：朝が苦手な会社員が、夜の習慣を1つ変える話

C1.name: サキ
C1.look: the young woman with a short brown bob and a white blouse
C1.desc: SAKI: Japanese woman, 28, office worker, short brown bob with side-swept bangs, round soft eyes, light natural makeup, slim build, white blouse with a navy cardigan

C2.name: マユミ
C2.look: the older woman with long black hair tied back and glasses
C2.desc: MAYUMI: Japanese woman, 36, Saki's senior colleague, long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, thin black-rimmed glasses, calm confident face, grey blazer over a black top

pages.scene: Bright morning in a small tidy apartment. SAKI bust-up by a sunny window holding a mug of coffee, eyes bright, a big refreshed smile, soft sparkles in the air. Her face occupies the LEFT half; the upper-right is plain bright wall.

text.text: 朝って|こんなに|気持ちよかった|んだ…！

pages.scene: Dim bedroom, early morning. SAKI sitting up in bed in pajamas, hair messy, eyes wide in panic, staring at a smartphone alarm clock in her hand; sweat drops, radial concentration lines. Her face occupies the CENTER-LEFT; the upper-right is plain dark wall.

text.text: 私はサキ。|28歳。|毎朝ギリギリ。

pages.scene: Office, wide shot. Concerned MAYUMI stands RIGHT; exhausted SAKI sits LEFT at a desk. Both faces are at the SAME height, entirely in the LOWER HALF. The UPPER HALF is EMPTY plain office wall, with no heads, hair, hands or objects.

text.text: サキちゃん|最近|顔色悪いよ？
夜つい|スマホ|見ちゃって…

pages.scene: Office break room, wide shot. Small figures in the CENTER: MAYUMI at center-right smiles and raises one finger; SAKI at center-left looks doubtful. Both heads below the middle line. Keep the UPPER HALF and LOWER-LEFT quarter as EMPTY plain wall.

text.text: 寝る1時間前に|《スマホを|別の部屋》へ。|それだけ

lines: 半信半疑で、試してみたら…

pages.scene: Early morning, bedroom bathed in soft sunrise light. SAKI stretching happily in bed before the alarm rings, the smartphone nowhere in the room, a small alarm clock on the side table. Her face occupies the CENTER; the upper-right and the left side are plain wall and curtain.

text.text: 3日目には|アラームより|先に目が覚めた。
